lane: CATHINT, lane 19: neutralizer/cathode system integration for the three thrust architectures
status: DRAFT for owner review. Evidence register for abep_sim/cathode_integration.py; no Hall prediction, no operating point.
evidence_policy: docs/EVIDENCE.md (evidence level 1-7 = source strength; quantity_type = measured / digitized / inferred / reconstructed / model-derived / assumed). Values from sources that were not read in full are never used.
cathode_baseline: Xe-fed LaB6 hollow cathode (RFP context: air + Xe, Hall preferred). Alternatives appear only as evidence notes.

boundary.note: This lane reports load-side power on cathode_keeper and cathode_heater. Bus-side conversion (efficiencies) belongs to the boundary lane; abep_sim.cathode_integration.to_boundary_ledger resolves that module lazily and refuses with a clear error when it is absent.

milestones.A: Supported: current-continuity identity (architecture-independent), a Hall-closure-free I_d envelope, cathode Xe mass vs the RFP 40 kg limit, start-up transient structure per architecture, and the poisoning evidence gaps written as explicit conditions ('architecture X is baseline provided the cathode is demonstrated at ...').
milestones.B_needs: admitted Hall transport closure or hardware measurement for I_d and I_beam per architecture; declared pre-ionizer/interstage circuit topology (and its net electron current if separately biased); selected cathode hardware with measured spot-mode minimum Xe flow at the required emission current; a published or measured LaB6 threshold for atomic O and the emitter-region partial pressures (shielding by the Xe flow).
milestones.C_needs: measured start-up profile and heater/keeper power on the selected cathode; heater start-cycle qualification; insert geometry and a wear/life test at the ABEP operating point; thermal integration (abep_sim/thermal_life.py); mission Xe closure including the Xe tank and any Xe used for thruster ignition.

firing_h_min.note: '> 15,000 h firing': used as the minimum

current_continuity.expression: I_emit = I_d + I_keeper + I_interstage ; requires I_beam <= I_d + I_interstage
current_continuity.locator: Sec. 7.2.3, p. 339, Eqs. (7.2-24) to (7.2-26): the Hall beam is charge neutral, I_d = I_ea - I_ia = I_e + I_ic (keeper current neglected), so I_d is approximately the cathode emission; keeper and interstage terms added by Kirchhoff (lane derivation)
current_continuity.applicability: floating spacecraft, current-free plume, steady state; ambient-plasma current collection neglected

discharge_current_envelope.locator: Eq. (7.3-3), p. 341: eta_T = T^2/(2 mdot_p P_in) <= 1 with P_in = I_d V_d + P_other (rearranged by this lane)
discharge_current_envelope.applicability: any thruster; mdot is the total exhaust mass flow; P_other must include every power that can reach the jet

richardson_dushman.expression: J = A T^2 exp(-e (phi0 + alpha T)/(k T))
richardson_dushman.locator: Sec. 6.3, p. 251, Eqs. (6.3-1) to (6.3-3); parameter sets in Table 6-1, p. 252
richardson_dushman.quantity_type: model-derived (thermionic emission law with fitted constants)
richardson_dushman.applicability: Schottky enhancement (Eq. 6.3-4) and plasma back-flow neglected, as in the IEPC-2017-276 life model (p. 5)

lafferty_evaporation.locator: Eq. (2), p. 5; constants in the Nomenclature, p. 1 (B = 36,850 K, C = 13); Lafferty's fit to polycrystalline LaB6 in vacuum
lafferty_evaporation.quantity_type: measured (Lafferty 1951, not read) -> fitted model -> transcribed from the secondary source
lafferty_evaporation.applicability: LaB6 in vacuum. IEPC-2017-276 found the net loss in a 4000 h wear test below this rate (redeposition, pp. 6-7)

insert_life.locator: Sec. 6.8.4, pp. 302-303 (evaporation-limited life; bore growth lowers T with time; 90 % of the insert assumed usable); non-uniform temperature and redeposition from IEPC-2017-276 pp. 4-7
insert_life.quantity_type: model-derived (constant temperature and area simplification by this lane)
insert_life.applicability: conservative against bore growth; not conservative against axial temperature peaking unless dT_peak covers it

flow_split.expression: mdot_p = mdot_a + mdot_c ; eta_c = mdot_a/(mdot_a + mdot_c)
flow_split.applicability: the 'fraction_of_anode_flow' law is only a bookkeeping form; the Xe-thruster fraction is not transferable to an air-fed anode

thruster_input_power.expression: P_in = P_d + P_k + P_mag (P_k normally zero during operation)
thruster_input_power.locator: Eq. (7.3-6), p. 342; heater off once the discharge supply is on and keeper normally used only during start-up, Sec. 7.2.3, p. 337
thruster_input_power.applicability: keeper may be needed in steady state below the self-heating current (IEPC-2015-43 pp. 4-5; IEPC-2017-365 p. 8)

mission_xe.expression: m_Xe = mdot_c t_fire + mdot_ign t_ign N_starts + mdot_standby t_standby
mission_xe.applicability: cathode Xe only; anode Xe (including any Xe used for thruster ignition) belongs to the Xe budget lane

flux_equivalent_pressure.expression: p = Gamma sqrt(2 pi m k T_ref)
flux_equivalent_pressure.locator: Sec. 3.4, p. 45, Eqs. (3.4-8) and (3.4-12): one-sided flux n v_mean/4, v_mean = sqrt(8kT/(pi m)); with p = n k T

qualitative_evidence.text: LaB6 cathodes have been used in oxygen and nitrogen plasma discharges at emission current densities exceeding 20 A/cm2 (no partial pressures or durations given).

Expansion of the unstable plume-mode region during a discharge experiment; O and C detected on the emitter; a cooler mid-emitter region with lanthanum carbide and a raised work function. Poisoning therefore couples to the spot-mode flow margin (and so to Xe consumption).

HT5k estimated cathode flow 1-4 mg/s Xe (Table 1, 2-8 kW class). RAM-HET with a Kaufman & Robinson SHC 1000 cathode: ~1.5 mg/s Xe always needed to prevent flame-out on N2-O2; after two days cathode ignition could not be achieved and the emitter was found damaged; Table 7 lists 'RAM-cathode failure (no insulation between keeper and emitter)'. The accessed text does not attribute the failure to poisoning. Ionization and acceleration supplies of the double-stage RAM-HET went into current limitation at 1 A and 3.7 A; where the first-stage current returns is not described (if through the cathode common, it is an interstage term in this module).

hall_only.status: phase order sourced (Goebel & Katz Sec. 7.2.3 p. 337; IEPC-2017-276 pp. 3-4; IEPC-2015-43 p. 4); powers and durations are inputs

phases.name: preheat
phases.note: heater raises the emitter to emission temperature

phases.name: cathode_ignition
phases.note: cathode Xe flow on, keeper voltage applied, keeper current regulated

phases.name: discharge_ignition
phases.note: heater off once the discharge starts; anode supply on

phases.name: keeper_off
phases.note: keeper off/floating once the anode current is nominal, unless the discharge current is below the cathode's self-heating current

hall_only.open: Magnet vs discharge order and the anode gas at ignition are not fixed by the accessed sources for ABEP. Cifali 2011 ignited on xenon and then transitioned the anode to N2/O2: if adopted, that anode Xe belongs to the Xe budget (not to the cathode).

rf_hall.status: PROPOSED (no accessed source fixes where the pre-ionizer starts; see docs/evidence/rf_source/ lane)

variants.V1_preionizer_after_discharge: hall_only sequence, then rf_source on after keeper_off: the heater never overlaps the pre-ionizer
variants.V2_preionizer_seed_before_discharge: rf_source on during cathode_ignition/discharge_ignition (seed hypothesis): check the peak against the bus limit when the heater is still on

rf_hall.note: The experiment-protocol draft orders ignition as heater, keeper, flows, pre-ionizer, discharge (variant V2 here); whether the heater is still on when the pre-ionizer starts decides the start-up peak

variants.V1_preionizer_after_discharge: hall_only sequence, then ecr_magnet, then ecr_source
variants.V2_preionizer_seed_before_discharge: ecr_magnet and ecr_source on before discharge_ignition (seed hypothesis)

ecr_hall.note: Resonance requires the magnetic field, so an electromagnet (ecr_magnet) is energized before ecr_source; a permanent-magnet design has ecr_magnet = 0 W.. The experiment-protocol draft orders ignition as heater, keeper, flows, pre-ionizer, discharge (variant V2 here)

cathode_dossier.observed: read-only in the cathode evidence dossier lane's worktree on 2026-09-26 (dossier base commit efc4a4e); not in this lane's base commit, so it is referenced by path and resolved lazily (abep_sim.cathode_integration.cathode_dossier_path), never imported or copied
cathode_dossier.authority: The dossier is the evidence authority for cathode candidates and alternatives, O2/H2O exposure statements, Xe purity, system precedents (PPS1350, P5, ECHT, NewOrbit), the uncertainty register U01-U18, the hardware-test gaps G01-G10 and the leads not read (e.g. lead.yang_2025, lead.andreussi_2022_aether). This file keeps only the values abep_sim.cathode_integration computes with (cross-referenced by dossier_ref) and integration-specific values that the dossier does not hold (Lafferty evaporation fit, SITAEL HC1/HC3 flows and heater powers, JPL start-up procedure and self-heating limit, Xe flow-unit conversion, RAM-HET cathode report, Suzuki 2024 abstract).
